mechanism: Distributed b1 residual + unnormalized weighted BF16 activation; per-CTA FP32 row moments, RMS scalar deferred through unchanged pool/router GEMM into route. No changed weight bytes.
changed_rounding: BF16(st*g) before GEMM, FP32 scalar after GEMM, instead of BF16(st*rms*g); TASK decides tolerance.
restrictions: FP32 residual and all weights unchanged; v1F coupled RT path unchanged; rows independent CTAs/clusters, no serial row loop.
